by: claude: tax back-fill 2015 onward, the four taxes the ten-year report reads (Switzerland: national rows and the 26 cantons)
note: Switzerland 2015 to 2025 (+ the 2026 wealth tax per canton). The wealth tax is cantonal and communal, so each canton is a region valued at its capital: top marginal rate, lowest band and taxed-from amount computed from the ESTV tax burden statistics (the federal tax administration's own per-year calculation, single person, no church tax). National rows (capital gains exempt, no federal wealth or securities tax) from PwC copies dated inside each year.

jurisdictions.structure_note: The wealth tax is cantonal and communal (26 cantons; each commune applies its own multiplier): one region per canton, valued at the canton capital. Income and inheritance taxes are also cantonal (to add per canton). Capital gains on private shares are exempt everywhere; there is no federal wealth tax.
